title: Listening Drill — Archives open day
description: Visitor briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Archives open day
sections.transcript:
GUIDE: Welcome to our visit to the city archives. Before we leave, make sure your name appears on the list I'm holding. If you can't see your name, speak to me privately rather than adding it yourself.

GUIDE: Our meeting point is the reading room. The visit itself will last forty-five minutes. You don't need to take anything heavy, but please bring a pencil.

GUIDE: We'll finish at the exhibition gallery. From there you can make your own way home. One last detail: pens are not permitted near originals. If you're separated from the group, phone the number printed on your ticket rather than taking a shortcut.
